jobs_user_kind_key_unique.name: jobs_user_kind_key_unique
jobs_user_kind_key_unique.where: "jobs"."userId" is not null and "jobs"."idempotencyKey" is not null

jobs_system_kind_key_unique.name: jobs_system_kind_key_unique
jobs_system_kind_key_unique.where: "jobs"."userId" is null and "jobs"."idempotencyKey" is not null

sync_connections_remote_scope_unique.name: sync_connections_remote_scope_unique
sync_connections_remote_scope_unique.where: "sync_connections"."remoteStudentId" is not null and "sync_connections"."remoteAcademicYearId" is not null

captured_source_assets_stored_shape_chec.name: captured_source_assets_stored_shape_check
captured_source_assets_stored_shape_chec.value: ("captured_source_assets"."state" = 'stored' and "captured_source_assets"."fileId" is not null and "captured_source_assets"."mimeType" is not null and "captured_source_assets"."width" > 0 and "captured_source_assets"."height" > 0 and "captured_source_assets"."byteSize" > 0 and length("captured_source_assets"."digest") = 64 and "captured_source_assets"."storagePlacement" in ('core', 'node')) or ("captured_source_assets"."state" != 'stored' and "captured_source_assets"."fileId" is null)

generated_artifact_revision_digest_check.name: generated_artifact_revision_digest_check
generated_artifact_revision_digest_check.value: length("generated_artifact_revisions"."manifestDigest") = 64 and "generated_artifact_revisions"."manifestDigest" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*' and length("generated_artifact_revisions"."outputDigest") = 64 and "generated_artifact_revisions"."outputDigest" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*'

source_ingestion_result_digest_check.name: source_ingestion_result_digest_check
source_ingestion_result_digest_check.value: "source_ingestion_revisions"."resultDigest" is null or (length("source_ingestion_revisions"."resultDigest") = 64 and "source_ingestion_revisions"."resultDigest" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*')

content_derivatives_size_check.name: content_derivatives_size_check
content_derivatives_size_check.value: "content_derivatives"."byteSize" >= 0 and "content_derivatives"."estimatedInputTokens" between 1 and 8192 and ("content_derivatives"."durationMs" is null or "content_derivatives"."durationMs" > 0)

content_sources_placement_check.name: content_sources_placement_check
content_sources_placement_check.value: ("content_sources"."placement" = 'core' and "content_sources"."placementRef" is null) or ("content_sources"."placement" = 'node' and "content_sources"."placementRef" is not null)

content_version_references_quote_hash_ch.name: content_version_references_quote_hash_check
content_version_references_quote_hash_ch.value: "content_version_references"."quotedContentHash" is null or (length("content_version_references"."quotedContentHash") = 64 and "content_version_references"."quotedContentHash" not glob '*[^0-9a-f]*')

corpus_payload_rewrite_source_check.name: corpus_payload_rewrite_source_check
corpus_payload_rewrite_source_check.value:
("corpus_payload_rewrite_leases"."sourcePlacement" = 'core' and "corpus_payload_rewrite_leases"."sourceNodeId" is null)
        or ("corpus_payload_rewrite_leases"."sourcePlacement" = 'node' and "corpus_payload_rewrite_leases"."sourceNodeId" is not null)

corpus_payload_rewrite_destination_check.name: corpus_payload_rewrite_destination_check
corpus_payload_rewrite_destination_check.value:
("corpus_payload_rewrite_leases"."destinationPlacement" = 'core' and "corpus_payload_rewrite_leases"."destinationNodeId" is null)
        or ("corpus_payload_rewrite_leases"."destinationPlacement" = 'node' and "corpus_payload_rewrite_leases"."destinationNodeId" is not null)

study_project_items_conversation_selecto.name: study_project_items_conversation_selector_check
study_project_items_conversation_selecto.value: ("study_project_items"."kind" = 'conversation' and "study_project_items"."trackingMode" = 'pinned' and (("study_project_items"."conversationBranchId" is not null and "study_project_items"."conversationHeadMessageId" is not null) or ("study_project_items"."selectorReviewRequired" = 1 and "study_project_items"."conversationBranchId" is null and "study_project_items"."conversationHeadMessageId" is null))) or ("study_project_items"."kind" != 'conversation' and "study_project_items"."conversationBranchId" is null and "study_project_items"."conversationHeadMessageId" is null)

assistant_model_preferences_budget_check.name: assistant_model_preferences_budget_check
assistant_model_preferences_budget_check.value:
("assistant_model_preferences"."maximumInputTokens" is null or "assistant_model_preferences"."maximumInputTokens" > 0)
        and ("assistant_model_preferences"."maximumOutputTokens" is null or "assistant_model_preferences"."maximumOutputTokens" > 0)
        and ("assistant_model_preferences"."maximumEstimatedCostMinor" is null or "assistant_model_preferences"."maximumEstimatedCostMinor" >= 0)

assistant_provider_claims_stable_key_che.name: assistant_provider_claims_stable_key_check
assistant_provider_claims_stable_key_che.value: ("assistant_provider_dispatch_claims"."providerSupportsStableRequestKey" = 0 and "assistant_provider_dispatch_claims"."stableRequestKey" is null) or ("assistant_provider_dispatch_claims"."providerSupportsStableRequestKey" = 1 and "assistant_provider_dispatch_claims"."stableRequestKey" is not null)

assistant_threads_placement_ref_check.name: assistant_threads_placement_ref_check
assistant_threads_placement_ref_check.value: ("assistant_threads"."placement" = 'core' and "assistant_threads"."placementRef" is null) or ("assistant_threads"."placement" = 'node' and "assistant_threads"."placementRef" is not null)

assistant_tool_sources_placement_check.name: assistant_tool_sources_placement_check
assistant_tool_sources_placement_check.value: ("assistant_tool_sources"."placement" = 'hosted-core' and "assistant_tool_sources"."placementRef" is null) or ("assistant_tool_sources"."placement" = 'node' and "assistant_tool_sources"."placementRef" is not null)

assistant_tool_sources_credential_check.name: assistant_tool_sources_credential_check
assistant_tool_sources_credential_check.value: ("assistant_tool_sources"."authKind" = 'none' and "assistant_tool_sources"."sealedCredential" is null and "assistant_tool_sources"."credentialHint" is null) or ("assistant_tool_sources"."authKind" <> 'none' and "assistant_tool_sources"."sealedCredential" is not null)

workspace_snapshots_sizes_check.name: workspace_snapshots_sizes_check
workspace_snapshots_sizes_check.value: ("workspace_snapshots"."byteSize" is null or "workspace_snapshots"."byteSize" >= 0) and ("workspace_snapshots"."fileCount" is null or "workspace_snapshots"."fileCount" >= 0) and ("workspace_snapshots"."capturedByteSize" is null or "workspace_snapshots"."capturedByteSize" >= 0) and ("workspace_snapshots"."capturedFileCount" is null or "workspace_snapshots"."capturedFileCount" >= 0)

workspace_snapshots_terminal_shape_check.name: workspace_snapshots_terminal_shape_check
workspace_snapshots_terminal_shape_check.value: ("workspace_snapshots"."state" = 'pending' and "workspace_snapshots"."committedAt" is null and "workspace_snapshots"."failedAt" is null) or ("workspace_snapshots"."state" = 'committed' and "workspace_snapshots"."workspaceSnapshotRefJson" is not null and "workspace_snapshots"."trustedObjectRef" is not null and "workspace_snapshots"."portableManifestDigest" is not null and "workspace_snapshots"."committedAt" is not null and "workspace_snapshots"."failedAt" is null) or ("workspace_snapshots"."state" = 'failed' and "workspace_snapshots"."failedAt" is not null and "workspace_snapshots"."committedAt" is null)

usage_events_adjustment_metadata_check.name: usage_events_adjustment_metadata_check
usage_events_adjustment_metadata_check.value: "usage_events"."direction" <> 'adjust' or ("usage_events"."adjustmentActorId" is not null and "usage_events"."adjustmentReason" is not null)
